newsitem.title: USA: Owens sees moderate sales growth rest of '96.
newsitem.headline: Owens sees moderate sales growth rest of '96.

text.p: Owens & Minor Inc said on Wednesday that is expects moderate sales growth for the balance of 1996.

"Sales growth is expected to be moderate for the remainder of 1996 as the company continues to focus on the profitability of existing business and obtaining new business that meets established profitability requirements," the company said in a statement.

Earlier, the firm reported 1996 third quarter sales were $744 million, up from $739 million during the third quarter of 1995. Net income per common share from recurring operations was $0.08, up from a $0.23 loss during the third quarter of 1995.
"The company's expected moderate sales growth has been primarily a result of the price increases and changes in management focus," Owens said.
